answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 652 Country: India Title: Can a girl marry a boy of her choice and whom she likes in islam? And if the parents do not accept her decision.what should she do? Can she go against? Question: Can a girl marry a boy of her choice and whom she likes in islam? And if the parents do not accept her decision.what should she do? Can she go against? Answer ID: 652 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 302=296/M) If the boy and girl are baligh (adult) and they happily marry in kufu (match/equal rank) then this Nikah will be valid. : کما فی الدر المختار: فنفذ نکاح حرة مکلفة بلا رضا ولی After all, it is recommended to have the consent of parents. And, if the Nikah is out of kufu ( match/equal rank) then it will not be even valid. It is prohibited to disobey parents without any justified reason: ولہ ای للولی اذا کان عصبة الاعتراض فی غیر الکفؤ ۔۔۔ ویفتی فی غیر الکفؤ بعدم جوازہ اصلاً وھو المختار للفتوی لفساد الزمان (الدر المختار: 4/155) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
